policy: Every ID in all_stable_ids has revision 1 dated 2026-08-20 unless an additional revision is listed in revision2 or revision3. Stable IDs persist across wording/difficulty changes when the assessed competency remains the same; a materially different assessed competency receives a new stable ID. Answer-key or keyed-option-position changes require a documented reason and source/reviewer check.
